title: Minimal legal rewiring and initial-voltage sensitivity calibration
status: Prospectively fixed exploratory follow-up to inspected preprint results; not independent preregistration
family: homogeneous only; one original E/I block-random graph
scope: Calibrate existing identified-chunk trajectory differences, not infer optimal topology or chaos
kernel: Unchanged frozen canonical-routing library, including dormant/refractory semantics

swap.allocation: EE/EI/IE/II:5/5/5/4; report all, no output-based selection
swap.operation: one legal same-arm, same-weight-bit, same-delay target swap from original; preserve source/row/weight/delay
swap.source_activity_check: Shared-original-source input discrepancy, only slots0:298 arriving by slot299 via n+2; zero drive is reported separately
swap.sampling: Independent seeded first legal proposal within each preassigned arm; this is a local intervention, not a fully randomized null graph

initial_voltage.direction: Independent seeded balanced signs:100E=50minus/50plus,25I=12minus/12plus/1zero; same direction across doses
initial_voltage.units: Uncalibrated model coordinate, not mV; record actual f32 magnitudes/ULPs
initial_voltage.placement: Before scheduler registration, all100 units in chunk share V; all other states unchanged
initial_voltage.activation: No added wake-up. Initial blocks remain Dormant; first executed voltage must equal supplied initial bits
initial_voltage.interpretation: Local starting-state calibration; contraction and common resets may erase differences; not online pulse robustness or Lyapunov test

archived_comparison: 57 explicit extensive-rewiring runs from19 controls x3 probes, plus3 original reference trajectories; reanalysed, not counted as new
primary_metrics: same1ms-bin normalized identified-chunk and population spike L1 as archived study
per-graph population/chunk ratio and1minusratio; undefined when chunk error zero
all19 values, median, range, zero counts per probe/control/dose
diagnostics: raw slot chunk mismatch and first spike divergence
fixed-original-channel standardized V/gE/gI RMS in0:80,80:150,150:300 and0:300
shared-source swap input mismatch and whether its difference can arrive within horizon
initial perturbation actual first-execution bits and first common reset/state recoincidence
statistics: Conditional descriptive calibration. No p-values, confidence intervals, pooled independent-amplitude counts, treatment optimisation, or threshold chosen after outcomes
gates: all231 count/state files consistent and finite
new analysis then clean-directory independent rerun
exclusions: No new original networks, no heterogenous-unit kernel, no runtime benchmark, no proxy changes; no dose escalation after observing zero effects
